newsitem.title: USA: Hartford buys Spanish Prudential unit.
newsitem.headline: Hartford buys Spanish Prudential unit.

text.p: ITT Hartford Group Inc said it has purchased Spanish life insurer Pricoa Vida SA de Seguros y Reaseguros for $6.2 million in cash from the Prudential Insurance Co of America.
The Hartford said it intends to merge Pricoa into its existing Spanish subsidiary, ITT Ercos de Seguros y Reaseguros SA, which is based in Bilbao.

Through the acquisition, Hartford has acquired all of Pricoa's life operations, as well as its $24 million in assets. Once the merger of Pricoa into Ercos is completed, the assets of the merged life operation will be $184 million.
The Hartford acquired ITT Ercos in May 1995. Last year, ITT Ercos wrote $73 million in total insurance premiums.

"This acquisition will boost The Hartford's presence in the Spanish insurance market and strengthen our Spanish life insurance operations," said John Donahue, senior vice president and director of international operations, The Hartford.
The Hartford is the largest U.S.-based property-casualty insurer in Europe and third largest U.S.-based property-casualty insurer operating internationally.
